title: Karuppu Durai
desc: Karuppu Durai, an elderly man, runs away from home after learning his family's plan to kill him using euthanasia. His life takes a turn when he meets a young, orphaned boy.

title: Pon Manickavel
desc: Pon Manickavel, IPS officer, is given the task to solve the case of a judge's murder. While his team attempts to crack the crime, the lives of high-profile persons are threatened.

title: Asuran
desc: A farmer goes on the run with his family as he is compelled to protect his son, who has murdered a wealthy upper-caste landlord in a fit of vengeance.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Arjun S/O Vyjayanthi
desc: Arjun, a gangster, learns that a terrorist wants to take revenge from his mother, who is an IPS officer. In order to protect her, he strives to overcome all the odds.

title: Thudikkum Karangal
desc: Balu works as a clerk in Ramesh's estate and is very loyal to him. However, when Ramesh accidentally kills Balu, the victim's brother Gopi becomes furious and decides to avenge his death.

title: Renigunta
desc: Five juveniles stop at Renigunta after escaping from Madurai's correctional facility. Subsequently, they encounter a mysterious figure who introduces them to the dark underbelly of organised crime.

title: Payanam
desc: When terrorists hijack a plane from Chennai, a struggle with the pilots damages the engine forcing them to make an emergency landing in Tirupati. NSG commando Ravi is entrusted with rescue operations.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Eesan
desc: Chezhiyan, the spoilt son of a minister, commits crimes but gets away with it. However, he is soon abducted by Easan and ACP Sangayya investigates the case only to stumble upon disturbing truths.

title: Manithan
desc: In order to earn quick money and fame, a struggling lawyer accepts a bribe and joins hands with a man who pretends to be a witness in a case. However, his conscience forces him to fight for justice.

title: Parking
desc: A parking spot frays the relationship between two neighbours of different generations and world views. Soon, the two men find themselves in an escalating battle to have the space all to themselves.

title: Nagashaurya's Aswathama
desc: A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

title: Takkar
desc: A man who wants to be a millionaire meets a woman with a distaste for money. Their chance encounter, however, leads to an unexpected adventure.

title: Maamannan
desc: A father and his son must reconcile their differences and face their past in order to defeat a late politician's privileged son, who is out to humiliate them.

title: Periya Veetu Paiyan
desc: A youngster from a small town falls in love with an emerging actress. However, his attention is diverted to an aspiring politician and his immoral actions.
